items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I kept him in the band.

ctx.x: he had to be replacing somebody in the saxophone section, because weren't you telling me one time that the reason--somebody else was supposed to come in the band but everybody was crazy about Lee because he could play trumpet and sax, and that was the reason. There was somebody else that they were supposed to get in the band.
No. That happened with the George Hudson case.
We were after another trumpet player.
